todays_decisions.reasoning: There are no proposals, so there are no trades and nothing to reject. Standing aside on buys is forced: cash of $64.78 is only about $2 above the 10% buffer. I am not citing L4 as a blanket idle-cash rule; the reason is size, and the account is 89.65% invested. I agree with the Market Analyst's risk-off stance (SPY momentum negative on every window, 20d vol 22.6% against 13.7%, rates, dollar and VIXY all against equities). The NVDA CEO-ouster report three sessions before its 11-17 print, from the News Analyst, adds to that. Breadth (RSP 21d +4.38%) and the regime line (stop block +4.33% for VOO and VTI) argue against forced de-risking. On the Skeptic's hold challenges: (1) WMT: I agree the sizing case is serious. It is 12.0% of equity going into an estimated, unconfirmed ~11-19 print with crowded PT raises, and a close-based stop does not protect against a gap (L7 open item). I can't trim without a proposal, so I raise the stop to $119 to protect the gain on cost before the print. I ask the Proposer to bring a one-third trim tomorrow unless a company-confirmed date falls outside the window. (2) VNQ: agreed, the stored premise (Market Analyst favor) is gone. He now rates it hold-not-add, and with him risk-off only the TLT leg of the invalidation remains open (TLT 2.23% below its 200-day vs the 3% trigger). I restate the thesis on its remaining merits and mark it the first equity sleeve to cut. (3) IEF: I disagree with a cut today. It is 1.31% below its 200-day, short of 3%; it is NEAR its $89.50 stop at +1.6% but not tripped; and at 2.4% of equity it is a small hedge for an equity drawdown. (4) VTI: I disagree. It is the Market Analyst's preferred broad US core and above the regime line, but there are no further adds to VOO or VTI. The Skeptic is right that the Proposer attributed the 11-17 NVDA date to the Market Analyst when it came from the News Analyst. Held-book review from the stop blocks (L7): nothing tripped. BND and IEF are NEAR (+1.6% each). BND's second clause needs the Market Analyst to be risk-on, and he is risk-off. WMT's XLP clause holds (XLP 21d +8.62% > +3%). VOO/VTI: RSP 21d is positive. CARG, MSCI and VRSN show no guidance cut or negative 8-K. DPZ has no confirmed guidance cut and is still on the menu with CFO above net income. KR's cyber clause is unconfirmed. INCY has no 8-K, and FAST no new report (News Analyst: no 4.01, 4.02 or 5.02 on any holding, L2). No dated macro print today; the rate-conditioned clauses (BND, IEF, VNQ) are checked above against the Market Analyst's 200-day distances. L6 fixes through thesis_updates: SPY 200-day restated to 728.65 (as of 11-11) for VOO and VTI. INCY's stop is now measured from the $119.37 fill. The unmeasurable 'trails XLV' clauses are dropped from INCY and IDXX, since neither stock's 21-day return is in the packet. Weight figures are removed from the BND, WMT and KR theses, and IEF's 200-day distance is re-dated. L3: no sector claims made.
